ruleset.en: Nightfall house rules: each role follows this library. Other editions may differ. Attacking wolves may self-destruct during discussion; the host decides when to move on. Night turns finish when all eligible players submit or the action limit expires; missing actions are skipped. Offline players keep their identities and do not pause the game. The narrator calls every scheduled role, including dead roles, and closes each turn automatically.
ruleset.zh: 暗夜自定义规则：以本角色库为准，与其他版本可能不同。参与狼刀的狼人可在白天自爆，之后由房主决定何时推进。所有可行动玩家提交或达到行动时限后，夜间回合结束；未提交视为跳过。离线玩家保留身份，不会暂停牌局。法官依次呼叫所有配置的夜间角色，包括已出局角色，并自动结束每个回合。

description.en: Discuss and vote. No night ability.
description.zh: 参与讨论与投票，没有夜间技能。

description.en: Vote with the pack on a night victim. A tied pack vote causes no attack.
description.zh: 夜间与狼队选择击杀目标。狼队平票则空刀。

description.en: Inspect one player’s alignment each night. Hidden Wolf appears village.
description.zh: 每晚查验一名玩家的阵营；隐狼显示为好人。

description.en: One antidote and one poison per game. Use at most one potion per night. The victim is shown only while the antidote remains.
description.zh: 全局各一瓶解药与毒药，每晚最多用一瓶。仅在解药尚存时看到狼刀目标。

description.en: On death, may shoot once unless poisoned, killed by a failed hunt, or killed through a lover, charm, or dream link.
description.zh: 死亡时可开枪一次；毒杀、狩猎反噬、殉情、魅惑牵连或摄梦牵连死亡时不能开枪。

description.en: Protect one player from the pack attack. Cannot protect the same player on consecutive nights.
description.zh: 每晚守护一人免受狼刀，不能连续两晚守同一人。

description.en: Survives the first exile by revealing, then permanently loses their vote.
description.zh: 首次被放逐时翻牌存活，此后永久失去投票权。

description.en: First night: link two lovers. If either dies, the other dies. If their factions differ after first-night choices, they win together by being the last survivors; this condition then stays fixed.
description.zh: 首夜连结两名情侣；一人死亡另一人殉情。首夜选择完成后若两人阵营不同，则以仅情侣存活获胜；此胜利条件随后固定。

description.en: Once, during discussion, duel a player: a wolf dies; otherwise you die.
description.zh: 白天发言阶段限一次决斗：对方是狼人则对方死，否则骑士死。

description.en: A dream target is immune to the pack attack and poison. Dreaming the same target twice consecutively kills them. If you die that night, your target dies.
description.zh: 梦游目标免疫当夜刀毒；连续两夜摄梦同一目标则目标死亡。摄梦人当夜死亡时目标随之死亡。

description.en: Swap two players for the pack attack and regular targeted night abilities. First-night setup choices are excluded. Each unordered pair can be used only once per game.
description.zh: 交换两人的狼刀与常规夜间技能承受对象，首夜身份设置技能除外；每组搭配全局只能用一次。

description.en: Learn the alignment of the player most recently exiled.
description.zh: 每晚得知最近一次被放逐玩家的阵营。

description.en: Mark one player at night; they receive one extra exile vote the following day.
description.zh: 每晚诅咒一人，使其在次日放逐投票中额外获得一票。

description.en: From night two, hunt one player: a wolf dies; otherwise you die. Immune to witch and wolf-witch poison.
description.zh: 第二夜起可狩猎一人：狼人死亡，否则猎魔人死亡。免疫女巫与狼巫的毒药。

description.en: Join the pack attack. On death, may shoot once unless poisoned, killed by a failed hunt, or killed through a lover, charm, or dream link.
description.zh: 参与狼刀。死亡时可开枪一次；毒杀、狩猎反噬、殉情、魅惑牵连或摄梦牵连死亡时不能开枪。

description.en: Join the pack. Once during discussion, self-destruct and take one other player with you.
description.zh: 参与狼刀；白天发言时可自爆并带走一名其他玩家。

description.en: Join the pack and charm one player each night. When you die, the current charmed player dies too. Cannot charm the same player on consecutive nights.
description.zh: 参与狼刀并每晚魅惑一人；自己死亡时当晚被魅惑者殉情。不能连续魅惑同一人。

description.en: Knows the pack, but the pack does not know you. Seer sees you as village. You cannot join the pack attack.
description.zh: 认识狼队但狼队不认识你；预言家查验为好人。不参与狼刀。

description.en: Does not know or join the pack. Inspect one player’s exact role each night.
description.zh: 不认识狼队、不参与狼刀；每晚查验一人的具体身份。

description.en: Join the pack. First night copy one player’s starting role: Seer, Guard, Witch, Raven, Gravekeeper, Demon Hunter and Hunter abilities are supported; any other role grants a nightly alignment check. Remain a wolf.
description.zh: 参与狼刀；首夜学习一人的初始身份。可复制预言家、守卫、女巫、乌鸦、守墓人、猎魔人、猎人技能；其他身份统一获得阵营查验。阵营仍为狼人。

description.en: Join the pack. Self-destruct during discussion to suppress village night abilities on the next night.
description.zh: 参与狼刀；白天自爆后，下一夜好人阵营夜间技能全部失效。

description.en: Inspect an exact role each night. From night two, an inspected wolf also dies.
description.zh: 每晚查验具体身份；第二夜起，查验到的狼人同时死亡。

description.en: Join the pack. Each night inspect an exact role, or use a single poison from night two.
description.zh: 参与狼刀；每晚查验具体身份，或从第二夜起使用全局一次毒药。

description.en: First night choose an idol. When the idol dies, become a wolf and join the pack.
description.zh: 首夜选择榜样；榜样死亡后转为狼人并参与狼刀。

description.en: First night permanently choose village or wolf. A wolf hound joins the pack attack. Choose before the action limit. If no choice is submitted, you remain in the village.
description.zh: 首夜永久选择好人或狼人阵营；选择狼人后参与狼刀。 请在行动时限内选择；未提交则保持好人阵营。

description.en: First night permanently become a Seer or Guard. This app’s reserve-role variant always offers these two cards. Choose before the action limit. If no choice is submitted, you become a Guard.
description.zh: 首夜从预言家或守卫中选择新身份。本应用的备用身份规则固定提供这两张牌。 请在行动时限内选择；未提交则成为守卫。

description.en: Charm up to two other players per night. Win when every other living player is charmed. Charmed players learn each other’s names.
description.zh: 每晚魅惑最多两名其他玩家；除自己外所有存活玩家均被魅惑时独立获胜。被魅惑者互相认识。

description.en: Win alone if exiled in the first completed exile vote. Otherwise become village after that vote.
description.zh: 在第一次有效放逐投票中被放逐则独立获胜；否则该次投票后转为好人。

description.en: Survive your first pack attack. If exiled, all village active abilities stop for the rest of the game.
description.zh: 免疫首次狼刀；若被放逐，所有好人阵营主动技能永久失效。

description.en: When an exile vote ties, you die instead. This app variant has no next-day voter selection.
description.zh: 放逐投票平票时替代候选人死亡。本应用规则不包含次日投票资格指定。

description.en: Win alone when exiled by a vote. Other causes of death do not win.
description.zh: 被投票放逐时独立获胜；以其他方式死亡不能获胜。
